direction.camera: Guide attention with data narrative; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: give one factual comparison the visual weight of a headline; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with one takeaway; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with editorial chart.
direction.lighting: flat readable graphic light; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: clean chart surfaces and controlled signal color; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around credible scale; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use data narrative,one takeaway,clear comparison,ordered reveal,credible scale,editorial chart as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
